purpose.domain_detail: GCSORT indexed file read test - reads an indexed VSAM-like file by primary and alternate keys
purpose.summary: This program opens an indexed file (masterseqfile) and reads all records sequentially via both the primary key (msr-01) and an alternate key (msr-99), displaying each record. It is part of a GCSORT test suite authored by Sauro Menna to test Sort/Merge and indexed file handling under GnuCOBOL.

notable_features: INDEXED file with ALTERNATE RECORD KEY WITH DUPLICATES
COLLATING SEQUENCE per key (ASCII and EBCDIC)
ACCESS IS DYNAMIC with START and sequential READ NEXT
ACCEPT FROM ENVIRONMENT for environment variable lookup
RETURN-CODE and GOBACK for error exit
GO TO used for error branching (lb-50)
Mixed tab/space indentation visible in source
verdict.notes: Source contains a tab character in the IDENTIFICATION DIVISION line and in some PROCEDURE DIVISION lines, which is slightly irregular for fixed format but consistent with GnuCOBOL tolerance. The program is a self-contained test/demo for indexed file reading, not production code.
